explication: Mobile Harness is an Android autonomous development workspace. The principal workflow is: a user opens the Compose workspace, selects or resumes a project, configures an agent/provider, submits a coding task, and receives edits, command output, previews, or an installed APK. Projects and conversations persist locally; agent bridges execute Linux tooling through native process spawning and the bundled PRoot/Ubuntu environment. Setup provisions runtime bundles and optional toolchains, while GitHub, provider APIs, Antigravity sign-in, and updates remain separate integrations. Some UI orchestration is unsampled, so uncertain calls are omitted.
